title: Lecture series
toc: true
---

The Palaeoverse Lecture Series is a monthly online presentation dedicated to software development and methodological approaches in palaeontology, with the aim of promoting the use of new tools in the field and to give researchers a platform to showcase their work. The format remains flexible and will generally include a short seminar followed by a demonstration of the speaker’s software toolkit and/or method, concluding with a Q&A session.

Important information:

- See past and future lectures on our [Events page](/events/)
- Lectures will be held from 15:00--16:00 UTC
- Register [here](https://bit.ly/palaeoverse-lectures) 
- All are welcome to join and we ask that all participants abide by the [Palaeoverse Code of Conduct](/about/code-of-conduct/)
